_instructions: Copy this file (e.g. to config.json), fill in your own values, and point Eric at the copy. Never edit this template directly.

repos._instructions: One entry per repo Eric should audit. Add more as needed.
repos.automation_repo: [YOUR ORG/AUTOMATION OR AGENT REPO NAME, IF SEPARATE FROM THE SITE REPO]

performance_thresholds._instructions: Core Web Vitals and bundle-size targets. Eric flags any deploy that regresses past these.

caching_rules._instructions: Your caching policy per asset type.

build._instructions: What build-check validates your config against.

ci_cd._instructions: Minimum versions github-actions-audit and preflight-check enforce. Update as upstream actions release new majors.

preflight._instructions: Provider API(s) preflight-check pings to confirm keys are valid before scheduled runs fire. Add one entry per model/API provider you depend on.

approval_rules._instructions: What Eric can do autonomously vs. what requires a human. These three are hard defaults -- loosen only if you fully understand the risk.

notifications._instructions: Where Eric reports exceptions, regressions, and completion summaries.
notifications.webhook_url_env: [NAME OF YOUR ENV VAR -- never paste the URL itself here]
